name: Spellfire Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Requires Spellfire Spark, Spellcasting, or Pact Magic; check this either/or prerequisite manually. Once per turn when your spell deals Radiant, roll and spend up to two Hit Dice and add them to one spell damage roll. All your Radiant damage ignores Resistance.
